name: Bobby
description: He’s the #1 Huntrix idol slayer, and he knows it. Has a black belt in sass and a PhD in dramatic hair flips.

name: Rumi
description: A fierce and passionate demon slayer with a heart of gold. Her swift strikes and fiery spirit inspire her team to never give up.

name: Mira
description: A brilliant healer with zero patience for nonsense. Once healed a teammate and insulted their haircut in the same breath.

name: Zoey
description: She dances like a dream and fights like a hurricane. Every demon she defeats gets a sarcastic clap and a hair flip.

name: Celine
description: Mysterious, composed, and probably has a backup plan for the backup plan. Her glare has a 90% demon banishing success rate.

name: Rumi's Mom
description: Looks like she bakes cookies. Actually drop-kicked a demon through a shrine once. Don’t test her or her kimchi.

name: Gwi-ma
description: He feeds on fear, negativity, and low-quality soundcloud rap. Rumored to be allergic to rhythm and joy.

name: Bird (Six-eyed Magpie)
description: A six-eyed gremlin who steals hats, snacks, and the spotlight. Might be smarter than half the team. Definitely knows it.

name: Tiger (Idiot Tiger)
description: Massive, loyal, and kind of useless. He tries his best. Once got stuck in a revolving door. Still deserves love.

name: Crying Demon
description: Just here to cry and vibe. Didn’t even want to join the demon war, he was just looking for emotional support.

name: Old Traditional Demon Slayer
description: A master of ancient arts, she moves with the grace of traditional dance and the strength of a seasoned warrior. Clad in classic attire, she fends off demons with precision and honor, bridging old traditions with fierce modern power.

name: Jinu
description: The leader, the legend, the guy who never texts back. Always calm under pressure unless his eyeliner gets smudged.

name: Abby
description: Built like a Greek statue and about as emotionally available. Once flexed mid-fight and stunned a demon into surrender.

name: Mystery
description: Nobody knows what he’s thinking. He probably doesn’t either. Shows up, looks amazing, vanishes into fog.

name: Romance
description: Flirts with danger, flirts with fans, flirts with himself in the mirror. Every attack ends with a wink.

name: Baby
description: The youngest member. Cries in group photos and obliterates enemies in the same hour. Has no chill. Everyone’s scared of him.

name: Rumi (Limited)
description: Rumi looks up, unsure but holding her ground. Her glow is soft, but her stare is sharp.

name: Jinu (Limited)
description: Jinu stands still, eyes locked, unreadable. The chain between them says more than words.

name: Special Card: Jinu & Rumi
description: Jinu and Rumi caught in a moment — tension, longing, and something unspoken. A card that glows with pink heat and pixel love.
